subject: Meditech: post-call security & private deployment next steps

Subject: Meditech: post-call security & private deployment next steps

Hi Alex / Security team,

Thanks again for the time this morning — good conversation. Quick recap and the concrete next steps we agreed to: 

- Redwood status: SOC 2 Type II is in progress (audit fieldwork scheduled Q4 2026; expect report Q1 2027). We maintain continuous controls and can provide interim evidence where applicable.
- Compliance posture: Redwood supports GDPR data-processing controls and has an optional HIPAA-ready configuration for covered deployments.
- Deployment modes: We discussed Hosted, Dedicated (VPC), and Private on-prem/air-gapped options. For Meditech's regulatory needs you flagged Private VPC or air-gapped on-prem as preferred.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Please confirm if Meditech requires true air-gap (no external egress) or simply network isolation inside a customer VPC.
2) Share any minimum architecture constraints (e.g., on-prem rack, on-prem HSM vendor, or approved cloud accounts).
3) Fill the attached vendor security questionnaire we use to collect baseline info.

From our side, action items:
- I attached the Redwood vendor security questionnaire (redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf). Please return with answers; we’ll route to security for a formal review.
- Neha will schedule a 45-minute technical deep-dive with our infra team to review network topology, KMS/HSM options, and audit log requirements.
- Priyom will send a short one-pager summarizing deployment capabilities and air-gap patterns.

Proposed times for the technical deep-dive (PT):
- Wed 2026-09-23 10:00–10:45
- Thu 2026-09-24 13:00–13:45

If neither works, suggest two times and we’ll do our best to align.

Thanks — looking forward to the completed questionnaire so we can scope procurement and evidence collection.

Best,

Karthik Iyer

Thanks Karthik — that summary is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we kick off the questionnaire: 

- Air-gap vs VPC: Our default preference is air-gapped on-prem for production PHI workloads, but we may accept an isolated VPC with no public egress for non-PHI test environments. Can you confirm which components of Redwood can operate fully air-gapped (without periodic internet reachability)?
- KMS/HSM: Do you support FIPS 140-2 certified HSMs and common vendors (Thales, AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM)? We require customer-controlled keys for certain scopes.
- Audit logs / retention: We need details on what events are logged and the standard retention window. Is log export to a customer S3/GCS/Azure storage supported?

We should also get procurement timelines on the table — we’re aiming to make a vendor decision by end of Q4 2026. If Redwood can provide interim SOC 2 evidence (control matrix + test evidence) that would speed internal approvals.

I can aim for the Wed 10:00 PT slot, but will confirm with security. Also please send the one-pager Priyom mentioned.

Thanks,

Alex Jones
Director, IT Security
MediTech Solutions

Subject: Re: Meditech: post-call security & private deployment next steps

Alex — quick technical clarifications below (high level; we’ll go deeper on the technical call):

- Air-gapped capability: Redwood supports fully air-gapped on-prem deployments via our Private package. That path runs the Redwood serving runtime and control plane in-customer; optional connectors for telemetry can be disabled. In that model no outbound internet egress is required.

- KMS/HSM support: We integrate with customer-managed KMS and HSMs. Supported options include AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, HashiCorp Vault with HSM-backed keys, and direct integration with on-prem Thales/Cavium HSM appliances. FIPS 140-2 compatible HSMs are supported; we can provide a compatibility checklist.

- Audit logs: We capture request-level telemetry, auth events, admin actions, and system-level alerts. Standard retention in hosted/dedicated is 90 days; for Private deployments we can configure export to customer storage (S3/GCS/Blob) with retention policy up to 7 years subject to procurement. We also support streaming of audit events to customer SIEMs (Splunk/Datadog/Sumo).

- SOC 2 evidence: As Karthik noted, our Type II report will land Q1 2027. In the meantime we can share a control matrix, recent internal audit summaries, and targeted evidence for high-priority controls (e.g., access reviews, change management).

Attached: deployment_capabilities_onepager.pdf — contains diagrams showing the Private (air-gapped) topology, VPC-isolated pattern, and recommended firewall rules.

I’ll join the technical deep-dive and bring our infra architect to walk the topology and answer questions about firewall rules, mutual TLS, and network ACLs.

Proposed agenda for the 45-min technical call:
- 10 min: Meditech constraints & must-haves (you)
- 20 min: Redwood Private topology + HSM/KMS options (us)
- 10 min: Audit/logging/export mechanics & evidence flow (us)
- 5 min: Next steps & timeline

If you confirm Wed 09/23 10:00 PT, we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,

Priyom Das
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

Attachments: deployment_capabilities_onepager.pdf
